newsitem.title: FRANCE: France commissions study of chemicals industry.
newsitem.headline: France commissions study of chemicals industry.

text.p: Industry Minister Franck Borotra has commissioned a study of the French pharmaceuticals and chemicals industries, the ministry said on Monday.

It said in a statement that Borotra had asked a former executive with French chemicals group Rhone-Poulenc, Francois Guinot, to "shed light on the outlook of the chemicals and pharmaceuticals industries in France" both in terms of their global ranking and competitiveness and financial performance.
Borotra last year commissioned a similar report on the French car industry which has not been made public.
